text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Well, that's about how it goes.
choice_data_list: I want to celebrate your victory!
Let's stay focused for the next race too.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
True that. Grabbing a bite to celebrate 
this victory wouldn't be half bad.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we peek into one of the back 
alleys around here?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I don't need any safe bets. I want a race 
that makes my skin tingle.
